resolution.note: select.ts drops a PR whose task an earlier first-parent commit named (the replay prompts with a task the parent already began). origin/main: 207 -> 165 units; v2/units.txt 130 -> 106 (dropped 613 606 601 592 586 585 583 577 573 563 557 556 502 467 461 460 459 458 457 454 452 111 110 108). title: D23 unit selection rejects tasks delivered before the parent or scoped to other repositories
body:
Why: the t-rmt64gs dev replay (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/stopgate/run1) ended 2 of 7 K runs without a commit, both correct stated-blocker escapes on invalid units: 467 (t-kfydr8a) changes other repositories, and 586 carries t-2yggc19 whose work was already delivered at the parent (ad71bae). Both sit in .krn/runs/d23-comparison/v2/units.txt, so the confirmatory run t-p70b19s would score them as K losses.
Outcome: evals/d23/select.ts refuses a unit whose task was delivered by an earlier first-parent commit naming the same task id, or whose task body scopes only paths outside the repository; the v2 unit list drops 467 and 586.
Proof: unit test of the selector on both cases; select.ts output on origin/main excludes 467 and 586.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/.
